actionConfiguration.body:
SELECT m.member_id, account.email, p.first_name,p.last_name,
public.issue19_has_role({{ this.params.email }}, 'document_reviewer') AS is_document_reviewer,
public.issue19_has_role({{ this.params.email }}, 'donations_reviewer') AS is_donations_reviewer
FROM public.person_app_accounts account
JOIN public.people p ON p.person_id=account.person_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
 SELECT member_id FROM public.members
 WHERE person_id=account.person_id AND status='active'
 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
) m ON true
WHERE account.email_normalized=lower({{ this.params.email }})
AND account.status='active'
LIMIT 1;
